title: Bitcoin holds near $77K despite hawkish Fed, CLARITY Act setback and weak ETF demand. Here is what experts say - The Economic Times
text:
Bitcoin held near $77,000 despite a hawkish Federal Reserve, weak crypto ETF flows and a Senate setback for the CLARITY Act. Experts said the cryptocurrency remains in a cautious recovery phase, with support around $76,000-$76,100 and resistance near $76,850-$77,000, while volatile ETF flows signal investor caution.
